description: Department of Inland Revenue - Specified the Guidelines to operate Simplified Value Added Tax Scheme that effective from 01.01.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification contains detailed regulatory guidelines for operating the Simplified Value Added Tax (SVAT) Scheme under the Value Added Tax Act. It specifies eligibility criteria, registration procedures, and operational rules for tax compliance, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or other specialized category.
